name: Leonardo AI
freeTierNote: Free daily Fast Tokens — check official limits.
priceBand: Free daily tokens; Essential — check official pricing
bestFor: Game-adjacent concept art and people who want a web UI on top of multiple models
skipIf: You already live in Midjourney and do not need a second subscription
keyFeatures: Web studio wrapping multiple image models
Useful presets for game and concept sheets
limitations: Output consistency varies across selected models
Weaker commercial IP story than Adobe Firefly
summary: A web studio with model choice and a real free token bucket. Quality depends on which model you pick that day.
body: Leonardo is a dashboard more than a signature look. That helps beginners. It also means two users can have opposite results. Fine for concept sheets. Weak as a legal story compared with Firefly. Token packs reviewed 16 Sep 2026.
notes: Read the license for the specific model you run
Good stepping stone before a Midjourney subscription
